method: Whole source read, traced input-to-rendering/status flow and disposable-target/interactive-input controls. Explicit wrapper errors, exact types/enum fields, native literal paths and check-only versus write behavior assessed. No asynchronous service/retry/SQL/HTML operation; subprocess ownership and process statuses remain explicit.

entries.judgment: Renderer reads exact consumed registry fields/types, finite role enums and target bool/kind before rendering; unrelated extension data preserved. Protected targets route to staging; Check only compares. Root Python heredoc literal, argv transport explicit. PowerShell provider probes literal. SHA utility disposed and UTF8 producers explicit. Output template transforms remain narrow two-format ownership, not a new generic rendering abstraction. Actual Bash31/0 and PowerShell49/0, with retained baseline red logs and unchanged live protected hashes.
